position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lots value = fixed lot size (absolute value used); Positive Lots value = fraction of free margin for position sizing

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a new-bar detection mechanism (comparing current bar time to stored time) to ensure signals are evaluated only once per bar. On a reversal signal, it closes the existing opposite position before opening a new one. The digit adjustment multiplies SL, TP, and trailing stop values by 10 when the symbol has 3 or 5 digits (brokers with fractional pip pricing). Trailing stop is optional and disabled by default (value=0).
python_conversion_notes: This is a straightforward MA crossover EA. Key considerations: (1) Implement digit adjustment logic for SL/TP — multiply by 10 for 5-digit/3-digit symbols. (2) New-bar detection must use bar timestamps to prevent duplicate signals. (3) Position sizing has dual mode: negative input = fixed lots, positive input = margin fraction. (4) Signal reversal closes opposite position first, then opens new — ensure atomic sequencing. (5) All indicator values should use previous completed bar (shift=1) for signal evaluation to avoid repainting.
